collision.doc: moveCircle(d, x, z, dx, dz, radius) -> (x, z) (the sim calls it through circleMover / actorMover); isBulletBlocked(d, x, z); lineOfSight(bulletBlocker(d), x0, z0, x1, z1) from src/sim/actors/helpers.ts. Inputs were drawn from Rng(0xc011) (the draw order is irrelevant to the port: use the stored inputs). walk: 400 chained moveCircle calls from entranceSpawn with radius 0.35, 50 calls per direction in order (0.1,0),(0,0.1),(-0.1,0),(0,-0.1),(0.0707,0.0707),(-0.0707,0.0707),(-0.0707,-0.0707),(0.0707,-0.0707); entries are hex(x), hex(z) after each call.
